author: GamingBolt
description:
Aphelion might be a bit of a mixed bag. On one hand, its story, visuals, and world-building are spectacular, delivering an experience that stands out enough in 2026’s lineup. But on the other hand, its gameplay is a tad too bland in comparison to the adventure you set out on. However, there's a balance between the two that makes this one an interesting adventure that trades spectacle and set-pieces for a more somber, reflective mood that works very well with the planet you're exploring.

Persephone isn't a friendly place, but it definitely is a beautiful one, and its hostile terrain and lurking threats don't take away from that. But is it worth a visit? Join us as we give you a look into what your time on this seemingly unexplored planet has to offer.
title: Is Aphelion The Emotional Sci-Fi Adventure Mass Effect Fans Should Play? (REVIEW)

author: GamingBolt
description:
Pywel has been a crucial part of Crimson Desert’s success, and not just because it hosts the titular Crimson Desert alongside all the other playable areas in the game. It’s because it has tied its disparate biomes into a seamless web of stories, adventures, and chaotic romps across its map that have been quite hard to put down in the month since the game’s release. 

It’s the stage of Crimson Desert’s evolution from a shaky release build to a confident version that’s now a very ambitious presence among open world titles. And if recent discoveries beyond the bounds of Pywel’s playable map are any indication, things could get a lot more exciting later down the line? What are we on about? Join us and find out.
title: Crimson Desert Has A Hidden Village Most Players Will Never See

author: GamingBolt
description:
The first rumours surrounding the PlayStation 6 have been swirling for a while now, and we can finally paint a somewhat reasonable picture of what Sony’s next leap in gaming could look like. While the company has yet to make anything official, consistent reports from industry insiders and analysts suggest a major shift beyond just raw hardware upgrades. 

From next-gen AMD architecture and AI-driven upscaling to the possibility of a dedicated handheld companion, the PS6 is shaping up to be more of an ecosystem evolution than a traditional console refresh. As speculation continues to build, we have compiled a rundown of some of the most credible PS6 rumours and what they could mean for the future of PlayStation.
title: PS6 - EVERYTHING We Know So Far
